adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` followed by `if group.save ... else ...`. For a HABTM/has_many :through association, `delete` on the association removes the join row immediately, so the subsequent `group.save` is redundant and its return value doesn’t reflect whether the member removal succeeded. This makes the code misleading and could cause incorrect error reporting if `group.save` were to fail for unrelated validation/state reasons, even though the deletion already happened.
